messages:
Alex (PM): Quick async check for Q3 OKR milestone 'Adaptive batching rollout' — want a compact status: what shipped, what slipped, owners, and next actions. Please reply with one line per person. Thanks :wave:
Sam (Eng): Shipped: batcher core + config UI. Canary at 20% in prod. Docs PR open: https://git.redwood/batcher-docs
Jin (Eng-Platform): Slipped: autoscale policy still pending — trying to reconcile cold-start P50. Owner: @jin. Next: I'll land autoscale heuristics today and push canary to 50% by EOD.
Maria (SRE): Observability: token-level latency reduced 12% on canary, but error rate up 0.8% on long-seq paths. Alert created: `OKR-AB-Err`.
Sam (Eng): Taking action on long-seq: adding prefix caching tweak, PR 746. ETA tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
Alex (PM): Can we confirm rollback window if errors spike? What's the threshold and owner to flip back to previous model?
Jin (Eng-Platform): Rollback plan: deploy-bot will auto-failover if 5xx rate > 1% for 5m, owner on-call: Maria. Manual rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback batcher --to-tag v1.12
```
I added the threshold to the runbook.
Maria (SRE): Confirmed. I'll tune the alert to 0.7% and annotate runbook with run-level steps. Also scheduling a brief postmortem if rollback occurs.
Sam (Eng): Code review pings: @alex please review PR 746 (prefetch tweak) — small change, test added.
Alex (PM): Reviewing now, will approve if tests pass. One question re: UX verbiage in config UI.
Sam (Eng): Noted, will split UX followup into a separate ticket (owner Alex).
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to 50% started at 1719999030. Logs: https://deploy.redwood/logs/ab-campaign-50
Alex (PM): Thanks everyone. Next steps: Jin push autoscale heuristics (owner Jin), Sam land prefetch PR (owner Sam), Maria monitor alerts & rollback (owner Maria). We'll reconvene EOD async. :calendar:
Maria (SRE): Added owners to the OKR card in the board. Link: https://board.redwood/okrs/AdaptiveBatching
Sam (Eng): Quick note — bench results vs baseline attached in PR comments.
Alex (PM): Perfect. If anything blocks, drop a one-line update here. :rocket:
